ai.title: Skip stop sequences for grok-code-fast
ai.summary: OpenRouter chat handler now omits stop parameters when modelId matches x-ai/grok-code-fast-1. Completion module received formatting cleanup. Change scoped to packages/internal/src/openrouter-ai-sdk/chat/index.ts and completion/index.ts. Conditional spread prevents upstream rejection of stop sequences for this specific model.

eli5.text: When the new Grok code model is used, the system no longer tells it to stop at certain words or phrases, which prevents the model from rejecting those instructions. You would not notice this directly, but models using this specific one will not get that extra stop command. This applies only to the internal setup and does not affect other models.

ai.title: Add base2-lite agent using grok-code-fast-1
ai.summary: New base2-lite agent configuration added under .agents/lite/. Uses anthropic/claude-4-sonnet-20250522 for orchestration but swaps editor and reviewer sub-agents to x-ai/grok-code-fast-1 and openai/gpt-5-chat respectively. Includes base2-factory.ts for shared definition logic. Affects internal agent definitions only.

eli5.text: A new lightweight coding helper called Buffy Lite is now available internally, which coordinates planning, editing, and reviewing for coding tasks. It still uses the same main orchestrator model but swaps in two different specialized models for the editing and reviewing steps, using a faster editor model and a chat-tuned reviewer model. The shared definition logic is now reusable, and the new files define how this lighter helper behaves. This is live today for internal use.

ai.title: Fix import path in agent-template-validation.ts
ai.summary: Corrects `DynamicAgentValidationError` import in `common/src/util/agent-template-validation.ts`. Replaces absolute `src/templates/...` path with relative `../templates/...`. Ensures proper module resolution within shared core utilities.

eli5.text: A behind-the-scenes fix corrected how one of the assistant's internal checks finds a needed piece of code, so that shared utility works reliably. It affects only the development tooling used to validate agent templates; you won't notice any difference in the assistant's behavior today. The change swaps an incorrect path reference for the correct one in a single file.
